state.shared_route: Original getter return PCs RX0=0x8400b76a, RX2=0x8400b898, TXDONE=0x8400b4e4 all enter the same assembly branch calling npu_emulation_packet_take. That function passes &npu_emulation_packet_state to npu_cold_packet_queue_take. One global state is declared; no independent TXDONE PKT state is declared.

head.injection: After all claims, private and native head are both incremented once, without changing count/bitmap. This makes head/history inconsistent while native/private heads match.

bitmap.injection: An extra bit is set in bitmap word511 after claims, without increasing count.
bitmap.source_predicate: The publication helper sums population of all512 words and rejects population != state->count.

plan.injection: Only private plan.packet_base is increased by2048 just before publication; owned state and bootstrap bases remain original.

state.definitions: returned0 is failure. ready_one_stores0 means no value1 publication, even transiently. Evidence scope is actual compiled C/native instructions with modeled platform inputs, not physical acceptance.
